title: TEJAS INFRA ONE
about: Tejas Infra One provides engineering, construction and contracting solutions across residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure sectors, from Hyderabad.
brief: The company needed a credible, professional online home that presents its range of construction and contracting work to clients and partners.
did: Designed and built a multi-page website: Home, About, Services, Projects, Industries, Careers, News, Blog and Contact
Carried a gold-and-white identity through the interface, with clear "Explore Projects" and "Contact Us" calls to action
Added a quick "Get In Touch" route, a tap-to-call link and an admin portal link
overview: Corporate website for Tejas Infra One, a Hyderabad-based engineering and construction contractor serving residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure clients. It brings the company’s services, projects, industries, careers and news together in one place.
design: A premium navy-and-gold identity: Playfair Display serif headlines over Montserrat and Plus Jakarta Sans text, gold rounded call-to-action buttons, a fixed header and a full-screen animated hero introduced with “scroll to enter”.
tech: Next.js and React, styled with Tailwind CSS, with Next.js image optimisation, a canvas-based hero animation, a floating WhatsApp button and an admin portal for managing content.
outcome: A credible corporate presence that leads with the company’s track record — 30+ years of experience and 500+ projects delivered — and gives clients, partners and job seekers a clear way to get in touch.

title: OLIVE OAK
about: OliveOak is the signature interior design identity of TEV Contractors, Singapore, serving homes and businesses in Hyderabad with turnkey interiors, design consultation and space planning.
brief: The brand needed a showcase that feels as refined as its interiors and turns visitors into consultation bookings.
did: Built a cinematic, scroll-led intro and animated hero
Created Projects, Services, Blog and Contact pages with project cards and article teasers
Added "Book Consultation" and "Begin Your Design Journey" calls to action with WhatsApp, phone and email shortcuts
overview: Portfolio website for OliveOak Interiors, a residential and commercial interior design studio working from Singapore and Hyderabad. It presents the studio’s services, featured projects and design journal.
design: A dark, luxurious palette — near-black backgrounds, warm cream type and champagne-gold accents — set in Yeseva One and Cormorant Garamond headlines with clean Outfit body text, opening on a cinematic “From Singapore, For India” intro.
tech: Hand-built HTML, CSS and JavaScript with GSAP and ScrollTrigger driving a scroll-scrubbed WebP frame sequence on canvas, served through Cloudflare with one-tap WhatsApp contact.
outcome: A story-led showcase that lets prospective clients experience the studio’s style before they enquire, and reach the team in a single tap.

title: HABAENE
about: HABÄNE is a travel-luggage brand built around the idea "Travel, Intelligently": a small, coherent system of luggage, carry bags and accessories, designed in Germany.
brief: The brand needed an online store that explains a connected product system, not just a list of bags.
did: Built a product grid with sorting, a comparison drawer and a cart
Added a three-question "Find Your Object" matcher plus product passport and pack-it-virtually features
Included order tracking, customer reviews, a shipping and returns FAQ, a journal and newsletter signup
Gave it a dark, bold, animated look with a Berlin clock, euro pricing and a region selector
overview: Direct-to-customer online store for HABÄNE, a Berlin-designed travel-technology luggage brand selling to Europe and India, with shop, journal, order tracking, press and full legal pages.
design: A crisp, editorial look: tall condensed Tungsten headings, Inter and Montserrat text and a handwritten Caveat accent, on soft off-white with deep navy type and a bright cyan accent, square-cornered buttons and numbered section labels.
tech: Custom HTML, CSS and JavaScript with Lenis smooth scrolling, a cart drawer, product filters and comparison, the “Find Your Object” matcher, Stripe checkout and Cloudflare delivery.
outcome: A complete shop from discovery to secure checkout, presenting the brand’s 4.9/5 average rating from 1,248+ customers and its 30-day money-back guarantee.

title: NAMMASWATHU
about: NammaSwathu offers end-to-end assistance with property documentation: registration and legal paperwork for farmland, residential plots, apartments and commercial spaces.
brief: A paperwork-heavy service needed to feel simple and trustworthy online.
did: Laid out a clear four-step "How It Works" journey and a free-consultation call to action
Built Services, Information Center, Latest Updates and FAQ sections
Added OTP email login with a "My Bookings" area and cart
Placed floating WhatsApp and call buttons on every page
overview: Service-booking website for NammaSwathu, which handles property registration and legal paperwork for buyers, sellers, tenants, landlords and NRIs, with around 40 services that can be booked online.
design: A friendly, trustworthy layout on white with a bright orange call-to-action colour, Urbanist and Bricolage Grotesque headings, icon cards that make legal services easy to scan, and animated illustrations.
tech: WordPress with WooCommerce for service pricing, cart and bookings, built in Elementor, with Swiper sliders, Lottie animations, OTP login, pop-up enquiry forms and WhatsApp.
outcome: Paperwork that once needed office visits can now be compared, priced and booked online, with each customer’s bookings kept in one account.

title: ORDIENT INFRA
about: Ordient Infra is a Bengaluru construction company offering home construction and commercial construction, including offices, retail, warehouses and luxury villas.
brief: Homeowners and businesses needed to understand costs and options before picking up the phone.
did: Published transparent pricing packages and a cost calculator
Added floor plans, Projects and Luxury Projects, a Home Building Guide and a Building Materials section
Included Blogs, Careers, Reviews and banking-partner pages
Built a contact form with a project-type selector, plus call and WhatsApp buttons, an FAQ and testimonials
overview: Lead-generation website for Ordient Infra, a Bengaluru construction company building custom homes, villas and apartments as well as offices, retail and warehouse spaces.
design: A confident, premium look — white space, dark slate text and gold accents — with Playfair Display and Poppins type, a fixed header and a full-width video hero, “Building Excellence Since Day One”.
tech: WordPress with Elementor and Tailwind CSS utilities, jQuery and Font Awesome, measured with Google Site Kit, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and the Meta Pixel.
outcome: Visitors can compare build packages (from ₹2,180 per sq.ft.), use the cost calculator and request a quote straight from the site, with every enquiry tracked for marketing.

title: INFRATRADEHUB
about: InfraTradeHub is a tech-enabled B2B marketplace and house of brands for construction materials, based in Dubai and serving developers, contractors and institutions across the GCC and beyond.
brief: The business needed a trade-grade storefront that handles a wide range of materials and large buyers.
did: Built a product shop with filters for category, price, length, width and thickness
Organised materials into wood, reinforcement bar, wire mesh, commercial steel, cement, electrical and hardware
Created pages for project supply, retail distribution, warehousing and re-export
Added a blog, careers, "Get in Touch", WhatsApp, an FAQ and client quotes
overview: B2B website for InfraTradeHub, a Dubai-based supplier of construction materials — cement, steel, tiles, electricals and hardware — to developers and contractors across the GCC and beyond.
design: A bold industrial style on white with an orange-red call-to-action colour, a sticky header, a large stats band, category tiles and image carousels that present the company at scale.
tech: WordPress with Tailwind CSS utilities, jQuery, Swiper carousels and Font Awesome icons, plus a filterable product catalogue and WhatsApp contact.
outcome: A searchable catalogue of 15+ product categories that shows the business’s reach — 500K+ orders delivered across 15+ countries — and turns visitors into supply enquiries.

title: ORDIENT VENTURES
about: Ordient Ventures is an export facilitator for infrastructure businesses, SMEs and new entrepreneurs, covering export documentation, customs house agent services, logistics and warehousing, buyer-seller connect and advisory.
brief: Exporters needed one place to understand each service and get started quickly.
did: Built service pages for export documentation, CHA, logistics and warehousing, Buyer–Seller Connect and advisory
Presented case studies such as cement to Oman, prefabricated structures to Saudi Arabia and steel to Malaysia
Added vendor registration, an enquiry form, WhatsApp chat, a newsletter box and client quotes
overview: Website for Ordient Ventures, which helps Indian infrastructure manufacturers and SMEs export — covering documentation, customs, logistics, warehousing and buyer connections.
design: A clean, modern look on white with orange pill-shaped buttons, a sticky header and a video hero, “India’s Infrastructure Export Launchpad”, followed by service cards and export case studies.
tech: WordPress built with Elementor, Tailwind CSS utilities, jQuery and Font Awesome, with enquiry forms, vendor registration, newsletter sign-up and WhatsApp chat.
outcome: A launchpad where manufacturers register as vendors and send export enquiries, backed by case studies of supply to Oman, Saudi Arabia and Malaysia.

title: BANGALORE PUPPY FARM
about: Bangalore Puppy Farm is a dog breeder in Whitefield, Bengaluru, presenting breeds such as Golden Retriever, Labrador, Poodle, Maltese, Bichon Frise and German Shepherd, along with grooming and adoption.
brief: Families needed a friendly, easy way to meet the breeds and reach the farm directly.
did: Created breed pages with per-breed Call and WhatsApp buttons
Built About, Puppy Grooming, Adoption, Gallery, Blogs and Contact sections
Added a photo gallery, testimonials, a newsletter signup and a chat pop-up
overview: Website for Bangalore Puppy Farm, a breeder in Whitefield, Bengaluru, offering Golden Retrievers, Labradors, Poodles, German Shepherds, exotic breeds and adoption.
design: A warm, friendly style with Poppins type, deep navy text and dusty-rose rounded buttons, photo-led breed cards, sliders, a gallery and playful animated puppy graphics.
tech: Bootstrap, jQuery and Slick sliders, with reCAPTCHA-protected forms, SweetAlert messages, Font Awesome icons, Google Analytics and WhatsApp on every breed.
outcome: Families browse breeds and contact the breeder in one tap, with KCI and AWBI licences and 24×7 after-sales support shown up front.

title: PESTCAT
about: PestCat provides pest control services in Bangalore for homes and businesses, including cockroach, ant, termite, bed bug, rodent, mosquito and wood borer control.
brief: Customers needed to pick the right service and plan for their home or office in a couple of taps.
did: Built Residential and Commercial sections with a plan selector by home size (1 BHK to villa, office) and plan length
Created dedicated pages for each pest service
Added Offers, About, Contact and Blog pages, customer reviews, a callback request and call and WhatsApp buttons
overview: Website for PestCat, a Bangalore pest control company serving homes and businesses for cockroaches, termites, bedbugs, mosquitoes, rodents and more.
design: A fresh, clean look in olive green on light grey, set entirely in Poppins, with full-width banners tuned for desktop and mobile, service cards and a customer review carousel.
tech: WordPress with a custom theme, Bootstrap, jQuery, Slick and Owl Carousel sliders, Font Awesome and Google Analytics, plus click-to-call and WhatsApp.
outcome: Customers choose a plan by pest, property type and visit frequency and request a callback in minutes, backed by 15+ years of experience and 40,000+ clients.

title: SHIVABAKTHI
about: Shivabakthi is a devotional and spiritual community website.
brief: The community needed a calm, easy-to-navigate home on the web.
did: Designed and developed the website with a clean, responsive layout
overview: Website for Shivabakthi, a devotional and spiritual community, giving devotees one place to come together online.
design: A calm, clean and responsive layout that keeps the focus on devotional content.
tech: A responsive website designed and developed by My3 Digital for phones, tablets and desktops.
outcome: A dedicated online home for the community that is simple to browse and easy to return to.

title: SIRI TRADER
about: Siri Traders is presented on its site as "Fast & Reliable Grocery Delivery".
brief: The business needed a clear, dependable web presence.
did: Designed and developed the website with a clean, responsive layout
overview: Online grocery store for Siri Traders, delivering daily home needs around Patancheru, Ameenpur, Isnapur and Beeramguda, with separate retail and wholesale ordering.
design: An app-like shopping experience on warm cream with forest-green accents and Poppins type: a fixed header, scrolling offers ticker, festive combo deals, category tiles and Today’s Deals and Bestsellers rows.
tech: A React single-page app built with Vite, with product, cart, checkout, order history, order tracking and profile screens, Lottie animations and Cloudflare.
outcome: Customers order everyday groceries online for delivery in about 30 minutes, switching between retail and wholesale in one tap.
